jobs_results.title: Back End (Java) Engineer
jobs_results.description:
- Remote Spain based -

Our Technology

Our Technology Team is made up of many small multi-discipline, cross-functional, autonomous teams, organised into business domains implementing highly independent self-contained systems. We build sophisticated solutions to solve highly complex business problems; we do so whilst simultaneously transforming our platform and supporting a business at scale. We use a wide range of technologies and cloud services to power our proprietary platform, and we seek simplicity by using the best tools available for the job. We value ownership, collaboration and encourage our people to work across boundaries. We embrace change, we grow, mature, take on new ideas whilst holding onto what is important to us.

What you will do:
• Plan, develop and improve the gambling platform with a very high degree of ownership (“you built it, you run it”) on a continuous delivery basis
• Design and implement interfaces to other high availability systems
• Collaborate closely... with software architects, product owners and stakeholders
• Be part of a highly collaborative agile process
• Use your experience and knowledge to support and make architectural decisions together with the software architects, play a part in the selection of new technologies, and promote knowledge transfer both within your team and between teams

Who you are:
• Experienced with OOP, design patterns, Java 11+ (CDI, JSF, EJB, JAX-RS), databases (NoSQL) and data structures
• Have excellent understanding of complex software architecture
• Familiar with cloud technologies like Kubernetes, Docker
• Experienced with tools such as IntelliJ IDEA, Git, Maven
• Highly familiar with agile development and continuous delivery
• Ensure high quality standards. Awareness of Clean code practices, as well as others (SOLID, KISS, DRY, etc.)

What's in it for you:
• A dynamic and highly motivated international team of skilled and experienced professionals
• An open culture defined by passion for developing software, fun and mutual respect.
• State of the Art technology environment and Continuous Delivery process
• Continuous learning based on a training & development program

Benefits:
• Private Healthcare
• 25 days per annum of annual leave, plus 14 bank holidays – that can be taken at any time during the year subject to management approval.
• Remote work allowance (equal to 50 EUR/ gross monthly)
• Educational opportunities
• Well-being support

Come as you are. And develop yourself.

We are a team of over 45 nations and many talents. Together we create a truly authentic and resilient workplace where everyone can be themselves.

We are an inclusive company. We value diverse approaches and multiple points of view. Diversity creates better ideas. That's why we build a culture where differences are valued.

Here everyone is welcome, regardless of who they are and where they come from. So that opportunities can grow for everyone

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Headquartered in the vibrant city of Barcelona since 2013, Immfly strives to revolutionize the airline industry through cutting-edge digital solutions.

With a strategic global presence and offices spanning across Europe, Asia, and North & South America, our scalable and customizable offerings encompass In-Flight Entertainment, Connectivity, and Onboard Retail. We reach millions of passengers across hundreds of destinations, Making Every Flight One to Remember.

Join our dynamic team and become part of a community committed to innovation, excellence, and enhancing the passenger experience.

The Role

We are looking for a talented Backend Developer ready to fly with us!

As a Python Developer at Immfly, you will be participating in the development of multiple services that allow users to interact with our In-flight entertainment platform uniquely. Among these services, there are entertainment platforms, e-commerce solutions, integration with 3rd party APIs, handling data, and creating... reports.

What your day-to-day will look like
• Work with the backend team and other teams to build high-quality client experiences
• Become familiar with the existing Immfly technology stack
• Contribute to architectural, design, and process discussions involving the technological choices involved in building Immfly’s browser-based clients
• You'll identify and uphold backend engineering best practices
• Create, build, maintain, and optimize the backend project, and help create a microservices infrastructure.
• Work with a wide spectrum of partners including design & product infrastructure to define best practices and optimal solutions

What you should bring

Technical
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (M.S or PhD)
• 2+ years of experience working on large-scale Python applications
• 3+ years of software development experience.
• Open Source user: You have basic knowledge of scripting on Linux systems
• Experience with CI/CD, Go, Rust, or any other backend languages
• You've made new architectures work

Personal
• You are a proactive, persistent, and results-driven person
• You are a continuous learner, with a huge curiosity
• You are organized with high standards of quality and precision in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, environment
• A team player with a positive attitude & energy
• Trustworthy and excellent work ethics

Why join Immfly?
• A full-time permanent contract with an attractive compensation package according to your profile
• Flexible Compensation Plan (restaurant, transport, health insurance, and childcare)
• Flexible working hours with a hybrid-remote work policy (intensive workdays all Fridays and in August)
• An international environment (20 nationalities) with a dynamic and disruptive team
• Limitless professional development at Europe's fastest-growing company in its category

jobs_results.title: Backend-Entwickler/In, Informatiker/In
jobs_results.description: Git, Backend, Objektorientierte Programmierung, Versicherungssoftware, IT, Informatik, Softwareentwicklung, Hardware, Datenbanken, Java We have something that will help you own: your next job! intersoft is an IT company specializing in insurance software and a wholly owned subsidiary of WWK Lebensversicherung a.G. We develop software solutions exclusively for WWK. The maintenance, modernization and expansion of our portfolio management system lifestream, which was developed especially for WWK, is our main responsibility. We are constantly on the lookout for innovative minds with ingenuity, acumen and ideas - not only to develop new IT solutions, but also to achieve common goals. In short: we're looking for you! Senior Backend Developer (m/f/d) What you bring to the table: You have sound know-how in the field of object-oriented software development with Java and have experience in the support and further development of a grown system You have conceptual design skills and are adept at... identifying, analyzing and documenting requirements - you are happy to take on testing independently after implementation You analyze the causes of problems both independently and as part of a team and enjoy cracking complex problems, researching errors and debugging You communicate complex technical content to your customers in a target group-oriented and understandable way and have a high technical and equally high professional affinity You combine your analytical, systematic and conceptual way of thinking with a high level of quality awareness and a strong focus on results You have a good sense for potential challenges, act preventively and share them with your team and stakeholders You find pragmatic and practicable solutions, are assertive and able to reach consensus You have already found your balance between focused work and team play - you enrich your team with your openness, motivation and proactivity You have trained as an IT specialist, have a degree in computer science or a comparable qualification - professional experience in insurance or finance is an advantage What you can expect at intersoft: You enjoy taking on technical challenges and always think outside the box. The fact that your implementations always combine the tried and tested with necessary innovations spurs you on to find the best possible and feasible solutions. You are passionate about sharing these results with your team and taking your product to the next level together - and you mainly do this remotely. We support you in growing in your role, bringing in your new ideas and putting them into practice - we offer you the appropriate playing field. This is what there is to do: Together with your team, you will develop software in the Provision subsystem as part of the functional expansion of WWK's core system You always keep an eye on the further development of the technical mapping of processes You have a desire to delve deeply into complex technical processes to ensure secure and valuable software in the long term Your tasks include driving forward the modernization and improvement of the maintainability of the code base through targeted refactorings - for this you develop business cases and are in close contact with the product owner You are jointly responsible for the technical requirements gathering - the evaluation, analysis and resolution of error tickets are part of your daily work, in close cooperation with your colleagues You are responsible for the quality assurance of your work and the creation of necessary technical documentation - you create automated tests, execute queries in the database and push your code changes to Git Your work does not end at the edge of your plate - in order to maintain your product, but at the same time develop it further, you work as deeply as possible into the existing system and thus build up the necessary specialist knowledge With your drive and experience, you help your team to achieve their goals and set new impulses - so you continuously increase your performance A proactive and solution-oriented way of communicating with colleagues at intersoft and WWK is part of it Convinced? Then apply for a job with us! Not convinced yet? Here are a few things that set us apart from the rest: Maximum flexibility and adaptability for employee satisfaction Symbolically open doors, flat hierarchies, family atmosphere Real teams that exchange information on a planned and spontaneous basis every day Central location and ideal transport connections Modern hardware and software equipment - whether in the office or at home Extras such as the Germany ticket, company sports, company social benefits, individual training programs Reliable job with prospects Free ice cream in the office, drinks, fruit and many other great employee benefits Good work-life balance and a pleasant working atmosphere Mobile first - as much mobile working as you want There we go, now! Sounds good? Then we should get to know each other. Please send us your application documents with your salary expectations and earliest possible starting date via our application form at ****** Your contact person in the HR Unit is Miriam. intersoft AG, Frankenstraße 18 a, 20097 Hamburg, www.intersoft.de You can find more information about the WWK Group at www.wwk.de * If you apply to us by e-mail, please note the following information: Sending by e-mail to our address ****** is usually unencrypted. This means that unauthorized access to your data cannot be ruled out. For security reasons, we recommend that you only send e-mails in encrypted form. Please do not send us any sensitive data by unencrypted e-mail. You can find our public PGP key for sending an encrypted email on our website at https://www.intersoft.de/assets/pgp_jobs.asc.txt. The fingerprint for this is: 345D F208 C278 94AF C05C 64A6 20AB 5058 0BF3 3FB5. Alternatively, you can send us your application by post. If you contact us by unencrypted e-mail, this is expressly on a voluntary basis and with your consent, Art. 6 para. 1 a GDPR. In this case, we also assume your consent to contact you via the communication channel you have chosen (unencrypted email) in order to respond to your request. If you do not wish us to do this, please let us know. You can of course withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Back-End
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete a una experiencia transformadora en el ámbito del desarrollo Web en Dempo! Somos una empresa de desarrollo de software en pleno crecimiento. ¿Quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo y evolucionar con nosotros?

📢 Buscamos personas apasionadas que disfruten colaborando, innovando y buscando constantemente el crecimiento. Al sumarte a nuestro equipo, contribuirás a proyectos de última generación, potenciando mutuamente nuestros logros.

Si eres un Desarrollador Web, es una oportunidad para ampliar tu experiencia, desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y avanzar en tu carrera junto a un grupo de profesionales motivados. ¡Acompáñanos mientras exploramos el potencial desarrollo web de varios sectores incluyendo EL SECTOR AGRICOLA 🚜

🎓 Para ello estamos buscando:

🎯 Experiencia mínima de 3 años en desarrollo web – back-end.

🎯 Conocimientos sólidos en el Spring framework. (Spring Data, Spring Boot y Spring Cloud)

🎯 Experiencia trabajando con Kotlin

🎯 Experiencia trabajando con... Java.

🎖 Valoramos conocimientos y experiencia en:
• Kubernetes
• Terraform.
• Docker.
• Helm.
• Git y Bash.
• Familiaridad con el sector agrícola.
• Scrum, Kanban o DevOps
• Herramientas de canalización CI/CD
• Proveedores de Cloud (preferiblemente Microsoft Azure)
• Familiarización en Testing en Aplicaciones Web.
• Habilidades de problema-resolución, comunicación y trabajo en grupo.

😌 Lo que estamos ofreciendo desde Dempo:
• Contrato indefinido. 📜
• Entorno de trabajo agradable. 😁
• Horario flexible (conciliación familiar). ⌚
• Oficina moderna en Forum Granada o teletrabajo. 🛢 /🏠
• Seguro médico privado. 🏥
• Presupuesto de formación para ayudarte a mejorar tu carrera profesional. 💻
• Con un proyecto a largo plazo. ☀️

¿Como funciona nuestro proceso de selección? 🤔

Primera etapa: preselección: valoramos tu CV

Segunda etapa: entrevista virtual para conocerte

Tercera etapa: valoramos tus conocimientos con una charla con nuestro equipo

Cuarta etapa: te citamos para vernos en persona y darte la bienvenida

En caso de no ser seleccionado 😔, ¡no te desanimes!

Contactamos contigo para comunicártelo

Te consideramos para futuros ofertas

¡En Dempo valoramos tus habilidades, tu experiencia, tus ganas de aportar y aprender, pero ante todo te valoramos como persona!

Con transparencia, ofrecemos salarios y niveles de carrera que reflejan tu experiencia y potencial:

💵 20.000€ - 25.000€ ➡️ Desarrollador/a Junior

💵 25.000€ - 35.000€ ➡️ Desarrollador/a Semi Senior

💵 35.000€ - 45.000€ ➡️ Desarrollador/a Senior

💵 + 45.000€ ➡️ Principal

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Back-end Developer

About Us

Spanish company based in Valencia founded by telecoms and software experts, focused on providing data intelligence with machine-based decisioning, automating network operations and customer assurance, to help operators to deal with the incoming increase of network complexity.

We are looking for a Back-end Developer.

What would you be doing?

As a back-end developer, you will be responsible for developing back-end components to improve responsiveness to requests from the front-end and overall performance, based on Django/Python.

Main responsibilities:
• Develop new features for our product.
• Write, audit, and improve our test coverage.
• Document our back-end codebase.
• Write clean and reusable code.
• Profile and improve our back-end performance.

Skills and Qualifications
• Degree in Computer Sciences.
• At least 5 years of relevant working experience in a similar position.
• Working experience developing web applications
• Hands on experience with... Python/Django & SQL.
• Agile methodologies.
• Design patterns.
• REST APIs and JSON.
• Unit tests.
• CI/CD.
• Good level of English.

Desired
• Selenium.
• GIS knowledge.
• React Native.
• Typescript.
• SQL Alchemy.
• Docker.
• GIS knowledge.

Benefits
• Competitive salary.
• Flexible working hours and short working days on Fridays and during summertime.
• Smart Work: you can choose Hybrid work model based in Valencia or 100% full remote.
• Udemy Business license & 2hours/sprint for training & learning.
• Cutting edge technology and innovative and challenging projects.
• Ongoing training and career development.
• Flexible retribution: Health insurance & childcare check.
• Exclusive discounts: Benefits Club Platform.
• International environment and the best working atmosphere.

This company is an equal opportunities employer and takes care to avoid any form of discrimination. As part of its commitment to diversity, gender equality and geographical distribution, it strongly encourages applications from female candidates, even if you don’t have 100% requirements but a similar role and applies a policy of equal opportunities. This company does not discriminate against anyone on grounds of gender, social origin, genetic features, disability, religion, or belief, political or any other opinion, sexual orientation, race, colour, membership of a national minority, property, or birth

Insight

If you want to join in a diverse team, where everyone has a voice and works as part of a team. Moreover, you have experience as a Back-end Developer, with a passion for solving business problems through innovation and engineering practice, then you are in the right place!

How will you make an impact?
• Participate hands-on Java planning, development, deployment, adoption of modern software engineering & delivery practices using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.
• Analyze business and functional requirements and translate technical requirements into programmed application modules.
• Build software and tools that increase the development velocity of every engineer without sacrificing quality.
• Tackle interesting and challenging problem on large scale datasets, high performance, availability, and reliability requirements.
• Partner closely with cross-functional teams including product management design, performance marketing, analytics, and others throughout the business... to give input into the end-to-end customer experience.

What Will you need to success?
• 3+ years of advanced knowledge of architecture, microservices, and designing of enterprise applications.
• 2+ years’ experience and strong expertise in object-oriented languages and design principles and methodologies. Experience with Java and the Spring framework is preferred. Development experience with any of the following are a strong plus: Python, C++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, REST, Scala.
• Demonstrate a passion for learning and a willingness to adopt new technologies.

• Good understanding of Agile development methodology and techniques.
• Fluent in English.

We are committed to keep a healthy environment for our employees, where they will feel motivated, creative, and focused.

• Flexible Compensation.
• Home Office Staff.

About Us

At Excibit Solutions Spain we are experts in technology and believe in its power to support our clients to reach their accomplishment, fostering excellence and increasing positive impact policy within the consultancy market. All based in our cornerstones: commitment, excellence, ethics and honesty

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are currently looking for a PHP / Laravel Developer responsible for managing back-end services for our web and mobile applications. Your primary focus will be the development of all server-side logic, design, and maintenance of the database, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front-end.

Responsibilities
• Be a prominent technical reference for the back-end team.
• Design and develop server-side logic using Laravel.
• Collaborate with Product Manager, Frontend Developers, Testers, and other teams to develop a high-performance PHP-based web application.
• Define and maintain the database.
• Create reusable, effective, testable, and scalable PHP modules.
• Implement security and data protection measures.
• Ensure the quality of the applications using the best practices and implementing end-to-end testing.
Requirements
• At least 5 years of working experience as a PHP / Laravel Developer.
• Strong knowledge of PHP and Laravel or similar framework.
•... Hands-on experience with SQL schema design, SOLID principles, REST API design, MVC.
• Proficient understanding and hands-on experience with software testing.
• Basic understanding of front-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (Vue / Livewire is a plus).
• Good analytical skills to understand existing code.
• Good level of spoken and written English.
Benefits & Perks
• Attractive compensation package
• Free membership on all of our streaming platforms
• Team sport activities with a personal trainer
• Development courses
• Flexible WFH
• Health insurance
• Flexible payment (transportation, restaurant and kindergarden)
• Free fruits are delivered at the office every Monday
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• Work in a location in the heart of Barcelona.
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international and diverse team of talented people to work with, all successes are celebrated together
